in_marathi.name: Lakshmidhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Lakshmi's abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshmidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshmidhar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Lakshmi (Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune) and Dhar (abode, dwelling). This name suggests a strong connection to the divine and a place of security and abundance.
